models_evaluated: hybrid machine learning model for single-lead ECG arrhythmia classification

links.outcome: External retrospective validation of previously trained ECG arrhythmia model on real-world data from new sites
links.effect: On external real-world data, sensitivity 98%, specificity 100%, accuracy 98%, PPV 100%, NPV 93%, F1 99% for any arrhythmia; false negative rate 1.9%.
links.quote: For any arrhythmia, the model had a sensitivity of 98%, a specificity of 100%, an accuracy of 98%, a positive predictive value of 100%, a negative predictive value of 93% and an F<sub>1</sub> Score of 99%.

screen.reason: The study is an external retrospective validation of a previously trained hybrid machine learning model for detecting arrhythmias from single-lead ECG data in real-world home hospital patients, assessing diagnostic accuracy rather than a deployment safeguard.
